content:
PR 1 landed. Read-only federation ingestion path is live (disabled by default; opt-in via POLARIS_FEDERATION_ENABLED).

## Surface delta
- polaris-backend/src/federation/{mod.rs, peer_subscribe.rs, verify.rs} — ~1200 lines new
- polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000027_federation_quarantine.sql (schema_version 28)
- polaris-backend/src/config.rs: +FederationConfig +PeerConfig +FederationDirection (~175 lines appended)
- polaris-backend/src/main.rs: +spawn_federation_worker_if_enabled helper + import wiring
- polaris-backend/src/lib.rs: +pub mod federation

## Architect verification
- cargo build -p polaris-backend — PASS
- cargo clippy -p polaris-backend --tests -- -D warnings — CLEAN
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --lib federation — 11 tests PASS (FederationError, supervisor no-op-on-empty, consume cancellation, key-cache hit/miss/expire, NSID filter, backoff math, URL format)

## Migration version note
Agent's worktree branched off an older base (81e8217) and picked migration 24 inserting schema_version 25; main has migrations 24-26 inserting schema_versions 24-27. Renamed to 00000000000027_federation_quarantine.sql + bumped to schema_version 28 before merging.
